description: This Java source file defines the 'ThingSearchCommandAdapter' class, which serves as an adapter to map 'ThingSearchCommand' objects to and from 'Adaptable' representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework. It handles translation between signals and adaptable entities related to 'thing search' commands, including specifying criteria, actions, and search actions supported by this adapter.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that maps 'ThingSearchCommand' instances to and from 'Adaptable' representations for communication within the Ditto protocol, handling header translation, signal mapping, and defining applicable criteria, actions, and search actions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of 'ThingSearchCommandAdapter' with the specified 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a 'ThingSearchCommand' signal to an 'Adaptable' object, using the internal 'signalMapper'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type string for the adaptable, combining a prefix with the search action if available.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria supported by this adapter, specifically 'SEARCH'.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions supported by this adapter, empty in this implementation.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether the adapter is for responses; returns false.

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of search actions supported: SUBSCRIBE, REQUEST, and CANCEL.
